stem: A toy truck is at rest on the floor. Which statement describes the forces acting on the toy truck?

options.label: A
options.text: The forces are balanced so motion occurs.

options.label: B
options.text: The forces are balanced so no motion occurs.

options.label: C
options.text: The forces are unbalanced so motion occurs.

options.label: D
options.text: The forces are unbalanced so no motion occurs.
